                            handbook = ?, diagram = ?, status = ?, priority = ?, sort_order = ?,
                            assignee = ?, needs_planning = ?, blocked_reason = ?,
                            target_branch = ?, updated_at = ?, version = ?
         WHERE id = ? AND version = ?
